business_problem: Addressing scattered customer information Previously, ProCredit Bank's outdated and siloed applications made it difficult to navigate client interactions effectively.
solution_summary: ProCredit Bank built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. Addressing scattered customer information Previously, ProCredit Bank's outdated and siloed applications made it difficult to navigate client interactions effectively. Key components included Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing, and Dynamics 365 Contact Center delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Contact Center, where Azure OpenAI Service assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Thanks to the new solution, ProCredit Bank improved first-time resolution by 23% and reduced customer wait times by 30%, improving customer satisfaction.
